label: rare original-phase step 1-2 tokens after a 2 (conjunctive, unresolved)
explanation: Extremely sparse (0.004% of steps). Fires almost only in the original phase at t=3..8 (peak t=4), never in the delimiter step and only once in the copy phase. Most activations come one or two steps after the digit 2 was input (prev2_tok=2 has 26x lift, prev_tok=2 has 14x). The input token is often l/o/c/a/d, and the first token is often u/g/w. But every predicate built from these conditions has precision under 3%: the large majority of matching contexts do not fire, so whatever it detects is a narrow conjunction not captured by these variables. The recorded predicate (2 in the last two inputs, original phase, t>=3) gets about 79% recall and mass recall with ~0.2% precision. Magnitude is small and fairly uniform (mean 0.12, max 0.18); the strongest examples tend to have two 2s early in the sequence, but this was not verified quantitatively.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=u (+3.74), prev2_tok=2 (+3.39), orig0=g (+2.97), orig0=w (+2.80), prev_tok=2 (+2.57), orig0=d (+2.26). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-3.83), prev3_tok=- (-2.01), next_out=- (-1.02), orig8=- (-0.73).
